mechanics_notes: 1) POST-CUTOFF CLASS — same constraints as Dreadful Roar. UPGRADE-OWED. 2) Hellfire Successor's transformation is structurally similar to other LA transformation identities (Shadowhunter Demonic Impulse, Souleater, Reaper Hunger) — a complete identity-skill-set swap during the transformation window. This is a well-established LA design pattern, but the Guardian-power theming and Halberd/Incarnation vocabulary is specific to Guardianknight. 3) The full-meter requirement (vs Dreadful Roar's 50%) means longer build phases between transformations — higher peak power per window but less frequent access. Classic power-frequency tradeoff in build-release identities. 4) 'Transformation timing as core gameplay' implies rotation flexibility (the Maxroll guide notes 'rather than following a fixed rotation') — the transformation window shapes what's available, so players adapt to the meter state rather than executing a fixed sequence. 5) MECHANICS-GAP: Incarnation Skill specific outputs (delivery, footprint, ailments) during transformation window are entirely unconfirmed.
